title: Coral and the Recipe
author: Casper Eriksen
blurb: Hazel Voss, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
